_comment: Maps a GitHub login to the Feishu user to notify, one row per person.
This lives in the Bitable rather than the repository on purpose: it is
organisation data, not code. Nobody should have to open a PR to add a new
colleague, the people who know the mapping are not always the people who
send patches, and putting colleagues' Feishu ids in a public repository
would publish them.
A login with no row here is simply not notified. There is no fallback to
a group chat: a message about someone else's failing PR is noise to
everyone who receives it.
Types: 1=text 7=checkbox.
github_login   exactly as GitHub spells it, e.g. 'liuhaoyutz'. The lookup
is case-insensitive, since GitHub treats logins that way
while this table stores whatever was typed.
open_id        Feishu user id, 'ou_...'. Application-scoped: it is only
valid for the app whose credentials the CI uses, so
replacing the app means refilling this column.
name           for humans reading the table. Never used for routing, so a
typo here is harmless.
enabled        unchecked pauses notifications for this person without
losing their mapping.
is_admin       also notified when a scheduled run fails. A nightly runs
on whatever is at the head of the branch, so it belongs
to nobody in particular: without a standing list there
is nobody to tell, and the alternative -- blaming
whoever merged last -- pages someone unrelated.
